name: Apache Kafka
certifications: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK)
Confluent Certified Administrator for Apache Kafka (CCAAK)

beginner.summary: For developers, data engineers and operators new to Kafka. Covers event streaming concepts, set-up with KRaft, topics and partitions, the command-line tools, producers, consumers and groups, offsets, keys and ordering, serialisation, Schema Registry, delivery guarantees, retention and compaction, Kafka Connect, basic Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, monitoring, security and client errors.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Docker and the command line
outcomes: Explain how Kafka stores and delivers events
Write reliable producers and consumers with schemas
Move data in and out with Kafka Connect and process it with Kafka Streams or ksqlDB
Run and secure a small cluster and read its health

days.topic: Event Streaming Overview and Kafka Setup with KRaft
subtopics: What event streaming is and where it is used
Kafka compared with message queues such as RabbitMQ
Apache Kafka, Confluent Platform and cloud services
Installing Kafka from the binary release
Kafka UIs: AKHQ, Kafka UI and Confluent Control Center
The course project: online shop events
days.lab_task: Start a three-broker KRaft cluster with Docker Compose, create a topic, send and read messages from the command line and view the topic in a Kafka UI.
days.deliverable: Compose file, command log and screenshots
checks: Three brokers and the controller quorum listed
Messages read in order from one partition

days.lab_task: Create topics with different partition and replica settings, stop a broker and watch leaders move, and show writes failing when in-sync replicas fall below the minimum.
days.deliverable: Topic settings and failover notes
checks: New partitions created and keys remapped noted

subtopics: Producer configuration in Java and Python
days.lab_task: Write a producer for order events with keys, acks=all and idempotence, measure throughput with different batch and compression settings and handle send errors in callbacks.
days.deliverable: Producer code and throughput table
checks: Same key always in the same partition
Throughput and size for each codec

days.lab_task: Run a consumer group of three for order events, add and remove consumers to watch rebalances and show that more consumers than partitions leaves some idle.
days.deliverable: Consumer code and rebalance notes

days.lab_task: Switch to manual commits after processing, crash a consumer mid-batch to see redelivery, reset a group to a timestamp and measure lag during a burst.
days.deliverable: Consumer code, crash notes and lag readings

days.topic: Message Keys, Ordering and Partitioning Design
days.lab_task: Design keys for orders and payments, cause a hot partition with a bad key, fix it, and prove per-order ordering holds with retries enabled.
days.deliverable: Key design and test results

days.lab_task: Send the same order event as JSON, Avro and Protobuf, compare sizes and parsing time, and add tracing headers to each message.
days.deliverable: Producer and consumer code and comparison table
checks: Trace ID received by the consumer

subtopics: Breaking changes and how to avoid them
days.lab_task: Register order schemas, add a field with a default under backward compatibility, try a breaking change and see it rejected, and run old and new consumers together.
days.deliverable: Schemas, compatibility results and client code
checks: Add a field with a default

days.lab_task: Build a read-process-write service with transactions, crash it mid-transaction, show no duplicates downstream for read_committed consumers and add an idempotent database writer.
days.deliverable: Service code and crash test results

days.lab_task: Set short retention on a topic and watch segments deleted, use a compacted topic for customer profiles, delete a key with a tombstone and inspect segment files.
days.deliverable: Topic settings, file listings and notes
checks: Write several values per key to a compacted topic

days.topic: Kafka Connect: Source and Sink Connectors
subtopics: Sink connectors: databases, S3 and Elasticsearch
days.lab_task: Stream new rows from PostgreSQL into Kafka with a source connector, sink events to S3 and PostgreSQL, rename a field with a transform and route bad records to a dead-letter topic.
days.deliverable: Connector configurations and test results
checks: Record lands in the dead-letter topic

days.lab_task: Capture inserts, updates and deletes from PostgreSQL with Debezium, read before and after values, add a column in the source and route outbox events to topics.
days.deliverable: Connector configuration and sample change events
checks: Event has before and after values

subtopics: Stateless operations: map, filter and branch
days.lab_task: Build a Kafka Streams app that filters invalid orders, branches by country, counts orders per product and test the topology with TopologyTestDriver.
days.deliverable: Streams application and tests
checks: Expected outputs for the test input

subtopics: When to use ksqlDB or Kafka Streams
days.lab_task: Create streams and tables over order and customer topics, enrich orders with customer data, count orders per minute and query the latest totals with pull queries.
days.deliverable: ksqlDB statements and query results

days.lab_task: Export broker and lag metrics to Prometheus, build a Grafana dashboard and alert on under-replicated partitions and growing consumer lag.
days.deliverable: Exporter configuration, dashboard and alerts

days.topic: Securing Kafka: TLS, SASL and ACLs
subtopics: Securing Kafka Connect and Schema Registry
days.lab_task: Turn on TLS and SASL/SCRAM, create users for a producer and a consumer, add ACLs so each can only use its topics and test what is refused.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, ACLs and test results
checks: Write to a topic without permission

days.topic: Handling Errors, Retries and Dead-Letter Topics in Consumers
tools: Spring for Apache Kafka or Python client
days.lab_task: Add retry topics with increasing delays and a dead-letter topic to the order consumer, send a poison message, fix the cause and replay it.
days.deliverable: Consumer code, topic set-up and replay evidence
checks: Moves through retries to the dead-letter topic

days.lab_task: Design events for the shop with naming rules, envelopes and IDs, document them with AsyncAPI and review them with a partner team.
days.deliverable: Event catalogue and AsyncAPI document
checks: All topics follow the naming rules

days.topic: Managed Kafka: Confluent Cloud, Amazon MSK and Azure Event Hubs
days.lab_task: Connect the shop producer and consumer to two managed services, compare set-up, security, limits and monthly cost and note code changes needed.
days.deliverable: Configurations, test results and comparison
checks: Produce and consume on each service
Monthly cost for the same workload

days.lab_task: Build an event-driven shop: Avro order events, inventory and email consumers with retries, CDC from the customer database, a stream that computes sales per minute, monitoring and ACLs, then demo a broker failure.
days.deliverable: Repository, schemas, connector configs, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Stop a broker during the demo
Goes to the dead-letter topic and the system continues
Each service limited to its topics
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one system

intermediate.summary: For developers and operators who run Kafka. Covers cluster sizing, broker configuration, producer and consumer tuning, Kafka Streams state, joins and windows, interactive queries, Connect clusters and custom connectors, Schema Registry governance, Spring for Apache Kafka, Flink with Kafka, multi-cluster replication, tiered storage, operating on Kubernetes with Strimzi, upgrades, client observability, testing, quotas, performance testing and the developer certification.
prerequisites: Writes Kafka producers and consumers with schemas
Uses Kafka Connect and basic stream processing
Runs Kafka with Docker or a managed service
outcomes: Size, configure and tune Kafka clusters and clients
Build stateful stream processing with Kafka Streams and Flink
Run Connect, Schema Registry and replication across clusters
Operate Kafka on Kubernetes and pass the developer certification

days.lab_task: Size a cluster for 200 MB per second in, three-day retention and replication factor 3 with one broker down, then validate the plan with performance tests.
days.deliverable: Sizing worksheet and test results

days.lab_task: Configure rack awareness across three zones, tune thread counts for the workload, keep unclean leader election off and measure the effect of OS settings on latency.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes and measurements
checks: Each partition's replicas in different racks

days.lab_task: Tune the producer for throughput and for latency separately, fix a consumer that keeps getting kicked out of the group and add parallel processing with ordering per key.
days.deliverable: Tuning results and fixed consumer
checks: No more rebalances from poll timeouts

days.topic: Kafka Streams State, Joins and Windows
days.lab_task: Join orders with payments within 15 minutes, enrich with a customer table, count sales in hopping windows with a grace period and suppress early results.
days.deliverable: Streams application and tests
checks: Send a late payment within grace

days.topic: Interactive Queries and Scaling Kafka Streams
days.lab_task: Expose product counts through a REST endpoint with interactive queries across instances, add standby replicas and measure recovery time when an instance dies.
days.deliverable: Application, endpoint and recovery measurements
checks: Correct count returned from the right instance

days.topic: Kafka Connect Clusters and Custom Connectors
days.lab_task: Run a three-worker Connect cluster, scale connector tasks, move secrets to a config provider and write a small source connector for an internal API.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, custom connector and tests
checks: API data appears on the topic

subtopics: Data contracts with rules and metadata
days.lab_task: Add data contract rules to order schemas, lint schemas in CI, block a breaking change and migrate it through a new topic version.
days.deliverable: Contracts, CI checks and migration plan
checks: Produce a message breaking a rule
Rejected or routed by the rule
Open a pull request with a breaking change

days.lab_task: Build order and inventory services with Spring Kafka, non-blocking retry topics, transactions with a database and Testcontainers tests.
days.deliverable: Services and tests
checks: Retries and dead-letter handled by Spring

days.topic: Stream Processing with Apache Flink and Kafka
subtopics: Event time and watermarks in Flink
days.lab_task: Compute fraud signals from transactions with Flink SQL over Kafka, use event time with watermarks, write results back exactly once and compare with a Kafka Streams version.
days.deliverable: Flink job, results and comparison
checks: Signals written to the output topic

days.topic: Multi-Cluster Replication with MirrorMaker 2 and Cluster Linking
days.lab_task: Replicate topics and consumer offsets to a second cluster with MirrorMaker 2, fail over consumers and resume from translated offsets, then set up active-active without loops.
days.deliverable: Replication configuration and failover results

days.lab_task: Turn on tiered storage for an events topic, keep one day locally and a year remotely, read year-old data and compare cost with local disks.
days.deliverable: Configuration, read test and cost comparison
checks: Messages served from the remote tier
Remote storage cheaper for a year

days.topic: Operating Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi
days.lab_task: Deploy Kafka with Strimzi using KRaft node pools, manage topics and users as resources, rebalance with Cruise Control and run a rolling configuration change.
days.deliverable: Manifests and operation logs
checks: Rolling restart with no client errors

days.topic: Kafka Administration: Partition Reassignment, Broker Replacement and Balancing
days.lab_task: Replace a failed broker, move partitions off a broker being retired with throttled reassignment, run preferred leader election and balance the cluster with Cruise Control.
days.deliverable: Admin commands, throttle settings and runbooks
checks: Client latency stays within the target

days.topic: Upgrades and Migrating from ZooKeeper to KRaft
days.lab_task: Migrate a ZooKeeper-based cluster to KRaft with no downtime, upgrade the brokers by one version and confirm clients keep working throughout.
days.deliverable: Migration log, upgrade log and runbook
checks: Cluster on KRaft with no client errors
All brokers on the new version

days.lab_task: Trace an order through three services and Kafka with OpenTelemetry, measure end-to-end latency and scale a consumer with KEDA based on lag.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation, traces and autoscaling evidence
checks: One trace across producer and consumers

days.lab_task: Add unit, topology, container-based integration and message contract tests to the shop services and run them in CI.
days.deliverable: Test suites and CI run

days.lab_task: Set produce and fetch quotas per team, manage topics through Git with validation rules, find unused topics and report usage by team.
days.deliverable: Quota settings, topic repository and usage report
checks: Request a topic breaking the rules

days.lab_task: Benchmark the cluster at the target load, repeat with a broker down and with compression changes and report p50, p99 and p99.9 latency.
days.deliverable: Benchmark report

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, check wrong answers by running small experiments, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Real-Time Order and Fraud Platform
days.lab_task: Build a real-time platform with Spring Kafka services, Kafka Streams order state with interactive queries, a Flink fraud job, Connect pipelines with data contracts, tracing, quotas and a replicated DR cluster, then demo a failover.
days.deliverable: Repositories, manifests, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Fail over to the DR cluster
Current state returned through the API
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior engineers, platform owners and architects. Covers broker internals, replication and KRaft controller internals, event-driven architecture, event sourcing and CQRS, sagas, large-scale design, multi-region strategies, platform engineering for Kafka, security at scale, compliance, very high throughput, low latency, Kafka for analytics and AI, streaming databases, cost, migrations, incident troubleshooting and Kafka strategy.
prerequisites: Runs Kafka clusters and stream processing in production
Builds services with Kafka Streams, Connect and Schema Registry
outcomes: Design event-driven systems and Kafka platforms for many teams
Run Kafka across regions with high throughput, low latency and strong security
Use Kafka for analytics and AI workloads
Diagnose incidents and lead streaming strategy

days.topic: Broker Internals: Log Storage, Requests and Replication
subtopics: Log segments, indexes and time indexes
days.lab_task: Inspect segment and index files, trace a produce request through request metrics, cause a leader change and explain how leader epochs prevent data loss.
days.deliverable: Annotated internals notes
checks: Time per stage from request metrics

days.topic: KRaft Controller Internals and Metadata Management
days.lab_task: Inspect the metadata log and snapshots, fail the active controller and measure election time, and add a controller to the quorum.
days.deliverable: Metadata inspection notes and failover timings
checks: New leader elected and the time recorded

subtopics: Event notification, event-carried state and event sourcing
days.lab_task: Redesign a set of synchronous services as event-driven, choose patterns per interaction, record decisions and review the design for coupling problems.
days.deliverable: Architecture design, decision records and review notes
checks: Shared schemas and hidden dependencies found

days.topic: Event Sourcing and CQRS with Kafka
subtopics: Events as the source of truth
Kafka as an event store: strengths and limits
When not to use event sourcing
days.lab_task: Event-source a wallet service on Kafka, build two projections, rebuild one from the start of the topic and handle an event schema change.
days.deliverable: Event model, projections and rebuild evidence
checks: Old and new events read correctly
Cases where Kafka is a poor event store listed

days.topic: Sagas and Distributed Transactions over Kafka
days.lab_task: Implement order placement as a choreographed saga and as an orchestrated saga over Kafka, fail payment mid-way and confirm compensations in both.
days.deliverable: Two saga implementations and failure tests
checks: Saga ends in a clear failed state

subtopics: Partition and topic limits at scale
Naming and ownership across hundreds of teams
days.lab_task: Design the Kafka estate for a bank with 300 teams, choose the cluster model, ownership rules and data product approach, and defend it in a review.
days.deliverable: Estate design, standards and review notes

days.lab_task: Compare a stretch cluster and replicated clusters for two regions, run a region failover drill with client failover and measure data loss and downtime.
days.deliverable: Design comparison, drill report and runbook
checks: Lost messages counted against the RPO

subtopics: Golden paths for producers and consumers
days.lab_task: Build self-service topic and ACL creation through a portal and Git, publish a client library with safe defaults and onboard a team end to end.
days.deliverable: Portal templates, client library and onboarding record
checks: Request a topic through the portal

days.topic: Security at Scale: OAuth, RBAC and Encryption
days.lab_task: Move clients to OAuth through the company identity provider, apply role-based access per team, encrypt a sensitive field on the client side and audit access.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, policies and audit report
checks: Read the encrypted field without the key
Reads of the sensitive topic listed by principal

days.topic: Compliance, Data Retention and Privacy on Kafka
subtopics: Deleting personal data: crypto-shredding and compaction
days.lab_task: Tag personal fields in schemas, mask them for analytics consumers, implement crypto-shredding for deletion requests and produce lineage and retention evidence.
days.deliverable: Tagged schemas, masking stream, deletion test and evidence pack
checks: Personal data flows traced across topics

days.lab_task: Push a cluster to 1 GB per second, find the first bottleneck, fix it and repeat, and record the configuration that reached the target.
days.deliverable: Benchmark history and final configuration

days.lab_task: Tune a trading-style flow to under 10 ms p99 end to end, measure the cost in throughput and durability and find what causes the slowest one percent.
days.deliverable: Tuning steps and latency report

days.topic: Kafka for Analytics, Lakehouses and Streaming Databases
subtopics: Streaming databases: RisingWave, Materialize and others
Real-time analytics stores: ClickHouse, Pinot and Druid
days.lab_task: Land order events as Iceberg tables, serve a real-time dashboard from ClickHouse or Pinot and compare freshness, cost and effort of each path.
days.deliverable: Pipelines, dashboard and comparison

days.topic: Kafka for AI and Real-Time Machine Learning
days.lab_task: Compute real-time features from clickstream events, score them with a model service, push product updates into a vector store for RAG and handle back-pressure when the model slows.
days.deliverable: Streaming pipelines, scored events and vector updates
checks: Vector store refreshed within a minute

days.topic: Kafka and Its Alternatives: Pulsar, Redpanda and Cloud Messaging Services
subtopics: Cloud services: Kinesis, Pub/Sub and Event Hubs
Kafka share groups for queue-style consumption
When to choose something other than Kafka
days.lab_task: Run the shop workload on Kafka, Redpanda and one cloud service, compare compatibility, latency, operations effort and cost, and write a recommendation for three use cases.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results, comparison and recommendation
checks: Run the Kafka clients against Redpanda
Platform chosen for each use case with reasons

subtopics: Follower fetching to cut cross-zone traffic
days.lab_task: Measure cost by team and topic, cut cross-zone traffic with follower fetching, move old data to tiered storage and report monthly savings.
days.deliverable: Cost report before and after

days.topic: Migrating to Kafka and Between Platforms
subtopics: Migrating from self-managed to managed Kafka
days.lab_task: Migrate topics and consumers from a self-managed cluster to a managed service with replication, cut over consumers one group at a time and validate no data loss.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, cutover log and validation report

days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (a rebalance storm, a full broker disk, a slow follower, producer timeouts from throttling and a stuck consumer), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Write a streaming strategy for a company: use cases, platform choice, team model, standards and a 12-month roadmap, and present it to a role-play leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Strategy document, standards and presentation
checks: Clear rules for events and services

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Event Streaming Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build an event streaming platform for a case company: multi-region clusters, self-service with guardrails, OAuth and RBAC, data contracts, analytics and AI feeds and cost reporting, then run a game day with region failover and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, game day report and board presentation
checks: Producing through self-service in a day
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
